text.en: We are a non-profit academic group studying intelligence that thinks continuously and generates together.
text.zh: 我们是一个非营利学术团队，探索持续思考、协同生成的智能。

text.en: We build open foundations for continuous diffusion language models and parallel reasoning.
text.zh: 我们为连续扩散语言模型与并行推理构建开放基础。

text.en: Supported by CUHK-Shenzhen and UCLA, with members from PKU, CUHK, HKUST, Oxford, UCLA, and beyond.
text.zh: 项目获得香港中文大学（深圳）和 UCLA支持，成员来自 PKU、CUHK、HKUST、Oxford、UCLA 等机构。

text.en: Young researchers are warmly welcome to shape parallel intelligence with us. Connect via
text.zh: 欢迎青年研究者与我们携手探索并行智能的未来。联系：

text.en: We welcome donations from institutes and individuals to help Polyadic Intelligence advance the frontier of open parallel intelligence.
text.zh: 我们欢迎机构与个人捐赠支持 Polyadic Intelligence，共同推进开放并行智能的前沿研究。

description.en: Build and understand models that generate language through continuous-state refinement. Study token representations, denoising architectures, noise conditioning, and scaling behavior.
description.zh: 研究通过连续状态迭代生成语言的模型，探索 token 表征、去噪架构、噪声条件与规模化规律。

description.en: Refine multiple token positions together, and investigate how sampling and verification affect generation. Evaluate quality, diversity, and end-to-end latency under explicit compute budgets.
description.zh: 共同更新多个 token 位置，研究采样与验证如何影响生成，在明确的计算预算下评估质量、多样性与端到端延迟。

description.en: Study how data, compute, and model design shape learning and generalization, and how continuous language models can support reasoning and action.
description.zh: 研究数据、算力与模型设计如何影响学习和泛化，以及连续语言模型如何支持推理与行动。

description.en: Collect and organize the best open-source continuous diffusion language models, with checkpoints, papers, and clear documentation.
description.zh: 收集整理优秀的开源连续扩散语言模型，汇集模型权重、论文与清晰文档。

description.en: Offer a unified API, one-click demos, and ready-to-run examples to load models, generate text, and compare methods.
description.zh: 提供统一接口、一键体验与开箱即用的示例，方便加载模型、生成文本和比较方法。

description.en: Share reproducible experiments, compare results, and exchange ideas through community contributions and academic collaboration.
description.zh: 共享可复现实验、比较研究结果，欢迎社区贡献与学术合作，促进想法交流。

description.en: Discuss open questions, share results, and build research projects together.
description.zh: 讨论开放问题、交流研究结果，共同开展学术项目。

description.en: Contribute model integrations, examples, documentation, or reproducibility studies.
description.zh: 参与模型集成、示例与文档建设，或贡献复现研究。

description.en: Young researchers are welcome. Tell us about your interests and the questions you want to explore.
description.zh: 欢迎青年研究者加入，与我们分享你的研究兴趣和希望探索的问题。

description.en: Donations from institutes and individuals help advance open parallel intelligence. Contact us to discuss support.
description.zh: 欢迎机构或个人捐赠，支持开放并行智能研究。请联系我们交流支持方式。

topicsTitle.en: Beyond one token at a time.
topicsTitle.zh: 探索逐词生成之外的可能。

topicsIntro.en: We study how continuous representations and parallel computation can expand the foundations of machine intelligence.
topicsIntro.zh: 我们研究连续表征与并行计算如何拓展机器智能的基础能力。

topicsQuestion.en: “Can parallel intelligence become a scalable foundation for language, reasoning, and action?”
topicsQuestion.zh: “并行智能，能否成为语言、推理与行动的可扩展基础？”

openSourceTitle.zh:
开放的模型库。
共享的研究基础。

openSourceIntro.en: We are building an open library of continuous diffusion language models. Our goal is to make strong models easy to discover, use, and study through shared tools, reproducible experiments, and community collaboration.
openSourceIntro.zh: 我们正在建设连续扩散语言模型开源库，通过共享工具、可复现实验与社区合作，让优秀模型更容易发现、使用与研究。

researchIntro.en: Our latest work explores a central question: what should a Transformer for continuous language generation look like?
researchIntro.zh: 我们最近的工作关注一个基础问题：面向连续语言生成，Transformer 应该如何设计？

peopleTitle.zh: 不同视角，共同的好奇心。

affiliationNote.en: Affiliations identify individual backgrounds and do not imply institutional sponsorship.
affiliationNote.zh: 机构信息用于介绍成员背景，不代表机构赞助。

joinIntro.en: Collaborate on research, contribute to the library, join the group, or support our nonprofit mission.
joinIntro.zh: 欢迎开展学术合作、贡献开源模型库、加入团队，或支持我们的非营利研究。

contactHeading.zh: 合作与支持联系 · Weijian Luo

footerMission.en: An academic collective with a nonprofit research mission.
footerMission.zh: 以非营利研究为使命的学术团队。
